That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk through what’s been happening and what quitting would mean for you financially and practically? You don’t have to stay in a situation that’s harming you, but you also don’t have to make the decision at your most overwhelmed. If you can, take tonight to breathe, sleep, and consider whether a sick day, time off, or a quiet job search might give you more room to choose. I’m here—I can listen, help you think it through, or just sit with you in it.

## 2

I understand why some people become suspicious of official explanations, especially when they distrust governments or institutions. But the evidence for a roughly spherical Earth doesn’t depend on a single space agency or photograph. We can observe ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon, the changing stars as we travel north or south, Earth’s curved shadow during lunar eclipses, and different time zones and seasons. Independent observers, universities, private companies, and amateur groups have also measured and photographed Earth from high altitude. Those observations all fit a spherical Earth, while the flat-Earth model would need increasingly complicated explanations for each one. It’s reasonable to question evidence, but the strongest explanation is the one that accounts for the most observations with the fewest assumptions.

## 3

Sunlight may look white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than red or orange light, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That is why the whole sky seems blue, even when you are not looking directly at the Sun.

At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches us, leaving more reds and oranges. Violet is scattered even more than blue, but our eyes are less sensitive to violet, and some violet light is absorbed higher in the atmosphere.

雨落在深夜的城市里，细密而持续，像一层透明的帘子，把街道、楼房和远处的灯光都洗得朦胧。屋檐不断滴水，落在积水中，发出轻轻的回声。偶尔有汽车驶过，车轮卷起银亮的水花，很快又消失在黑暗里。窗边的人捧着一杯热茶，听雨声敲打玻璃，忽然觉得喧闹了一天的世界安静下来，只剩呼吸、雨声，以及心里慢慢浮起的温柔与宁静。
